title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
abstract: arXiv:2610.28416v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V

tldr: 提出了Code2Video-Compass——首个覆盖文生视频、图生视频与视频转视频三种输入模态、包含2,104个任务、10个类别及三个复杂度维度的通用代码式视频生成综合评测基准。
en_tdlr: Code2Video-Compass is the first comprehensive general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation, spanning T2V, I2V, and V2V settings with 2,104 tasks across 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions.
